metadata.description: MiniMax-M3 compute-side roofline selections from the 18-case native ATOM/AITER study; ATOM ownership is separate from AITER.
metadata.selection_rule: Useful work / estimated logical bytes > compute reference / HBM reference. Compute-side roofline classification is not proof of an observed compute bottleneck. Integer compare counts are separate from FLOPs.

minimax-m3.model_attribution: MiniMax-M3 indexer cases selected from the 18-case native kernel study; not an end-to-end model benchmark.

kernels.label: MiniMax-M3 Prefill index score

roofline.work_definition: 2 * head_dim * sum(prefix + row + 1 for each query row); excludes masked dot positions and non-dot work
roofline.byte_definition: Logical tensor read/write proxy, not measured HBM traffic; cache reuse and repeated physical reads are not inferred.

performance.measurement: Median of three process means; 10,000 target dispatches/process. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace device timestamps, with unmodified AITER rotating buffers and CUDA graph replay. Setup, independent oracles and warmup excluded.
performance.scope: One native target kernel per invocation; packed_topk includes sparse page emission but excludes score generation.
performance.correctness: 16 query rows, all valid context blocks against FP32 FP8-query scoring; reduced full UT and composed-wrapper parity also passed.

notes: Run from the corpus root in a compatible pinned ATOM/AITER environment under the shared GPU lock.
The corpus command validates and exports exactly one target LLVM IR; it does not benchmark. Performance above comes from the separate rotating-buffer profiler experiment.
Native source and launch policy are unchanged. Full output is checked for top-k; score checks 16 query rows against FP32 plus full Q31/Q257 boundary checks.
FP8 QK dot with BF16 input query cast to FP8 in the native kernel.

correctness.method: 16 query rows against FP32 scoring; full Q31/Q257 boundary checks.

extraction_validation.note: IR fingerprint is evidence for this compiler revision, not a required hash for future codegen.
